rows.label: lem:app-power-mean-hessian

rows.label: lem:app-monomial-hessian
rows.title: Hessian and sign classification of a monomial
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves the line-Hessian identity and both iff sign classifications.

rows.label: lem:app-renyi-continuity
rows.title: Continuity and uniform bound for finite-dimensional Renyi entropy
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves global endpoint-aware continuity and the sharp support-cardinality bound.

rows.label: lem:app-renyi-shape
rows.title: Concavity and Schur concavity in the sufficient ranges
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade packages simplex concavity and endpoint-aware Schur concavity.

rows.label: lem:app-measure-tools
rows.title: Measure-theoretic tools
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade packages Mathlib's dominated convergence, monotone convergence, and Fubini theorems.

rows.label: lem:app-common-discretisation
rows.title: Common discrete approximation of the Renyi parameter
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves the pushforward identity and dominated-convergence limit for arbitrary measurable finite-range maps.

rows.label: lem:app-pointwise-shape
rows.title: Pointwise limits preserve shape inequalities
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves closure of concavity, convexity, and quasiconvexity on an arbitrary convex set.

rows.label: lem:app-ell-derivatives
rows.title: First and second derivatives of the logarithmic power mean
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves the escort mean, second-moment, and variance derivative formulas.

rows.label: lem:app-Shannon-cancellation
rows.title: Cancellation and continuity through the Shannon point
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves joint entropy-line continuity through the Shannon order and the exact pole-cancellation integral identity for derivative orders zero, one, and two.

rows.label: lem:app-endpoint-differentiability
rows.title: Continuity of differentiated entropy at the parameter endpoints
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade is the endpoint-aware derivative and joint-continuity bundle under the stable-max hypothesis.

rows.label: prop:app-fixed-d-interchange
rows.title: Differentiation under the Renyi-parameter integral
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves C2 regularity and both signed-integral derivative identities without a moment hypothesis.

rows.label: lem:app-dominant-block
rows.title: Dominant-block remainder
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves both first- and second-derivative dominant-block remainder bounds.

rows.label: lem:app-Shannon-covariance
rows.title: First two derivatives of Shannon entropy along an affine path
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade states the first covariance sum explicitly and the equivalent variance-covariance second derivative.

rows.label: lem:app-quasiconvex-stationary
rows.title: Stationary second-order condition for a quasiconvex function
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade proves the stationary second-order condition for a twice differentiable quasiconvex curve.

rows.label: lem:app-exact-stationarity
rows.title: Exact finite-dimensional stationarity correction
rows.statusDetail: Canonical facade constructs exactly stationary corrected directions and proves direction and curvature convergence.
